You are building chunk C1 of cpanel-mail-mcp, a Cloudflare Worker remote MCP server that gives Claude IMAP access to Scott's three cPanel business mailboxes. Read `docs/spec.md` (tag `spec-v1.3`), `docs/build/traceability.md`, `docs/prerequisites.md` and `docs/build/spec-questions.md` before writing code.

## Goal

Turn the spike IMAP client into the production client in `src/imap/`, on cloudflare:sockets, with every command, timeout and failure rule the spec requires.

## Rules for this chunk (read first)

1. Build to `docs/spec.md` at git tag `spec-v1.3`. Do not edit `docs/spec.md`, `docs/rule-base.md`, `docs/ambiguity-log.md` or `docs/design.md`.
2. Implement only the requirements listed under "In scope". Do not add behavior the spec does not state, even if it seems obviously useful.
3. If a requirement is unclear, contradicts another, or needs a decision the spec does not make: do not decide it. Add an entry to `docs/build/spec-questions.md` (format below), skip that item, finish the rest, and list the question in the PR. Scott resolves it and, if needed, the spec gets a version bump.
4. Every automated test's name starts with the REQ IDs it verifies, for example `REQ-4-7 REQ-4-8: greeting times out after 5 s`.
5. Add `node scripts/trace.mjs --chunk C1 --strict` to the unit job in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, next to the earlier chunks' lines.
5a. Fill the "Verified by" column of `docs/build/traceability.md` for every in-scope row (test file and test name, or the manual check to perform). Set Status to `built` for automated rows that pass, or `needs Scott` for manual rows.
6. No secrets in the repo, logs, test output or PR. Passwords are entered by Scott with `wrangler secret put` only. Never print a secret value.
7. Work on branch `chunk/C1`. Open a pull request titled `C1: IMAP client`. Do not merge it. Stop after opening the PR.
8. The PR description contains: in-scope REQs and their status, the exact commands you ran with their pass/fail results, anything deferred and why, and any spec questions raised.

Spec question format (append to `docs/build/spec-questions.md`):

```
## Q<n> (C1)
REQ: <id(s)>
```

## In scope (19 requirements)

| REQ | Method | Requirement (summary; the spec text governs) |
|---|---|---|
| REQ-4-1 | automated test | The server uses a minimal IMAP client written on cloudflare:sockets, not imapflow, implementing only the commands the design needs. |
| REQ-4-2 | automated test | IMAP login uses AUTHENTICATE PLAIN with SASL-IR, so password characters need no escaping. |
| REQ-4-3 | automated test | The client supports at minimum login (AUTHENTICATE PLAIN with SASL-IR), LIST, SELECT, SEARCH, FETCH, APPEND and STORE of flags. |
| REQ-4-4 | automated test | The client also supports CAPABILITY, FETCH BODYSTRUCTURE and partial BODY.PEEK fetches. |
| REQ-4-5 | automated test | To move a message the client uses MOVE when the host advertises it; otherwise it uses UID COPY plus STORE `\Deleted` plus UID EXPUNGE, which requires UIDPLUS. |
| REQ-4-6 | automated test | The client handles LITERAL+ both on and off, and literal mailbox names. |
| REQ-4-7 | automated test | Every network step has an explicit timeout; no step may hang the request. |
| REQ-4-8 | automated test | Timeout values: TCP plus TLS 10 s; greeting 5 s; login 10 s; each command 15 s; APPEND 30 s. |
| REQ-4-9 | automated test | A timeout fails that account loudly, never the whole call. |
| REQ-4-10 | automated test | One IMAP session per account per request, opened lazily and closed at request end; no persistent connections and no pooling. |
| REQ-4-11 | automated test | Operations run in parallel across hosts and sequentially within a host; the two cPanel B accounts run one after the other. |
| REQ-4-12 | automated test | On any IMAP authentication failure the account is disabled for the rest of the request, the error tells the caller to check the secret, and there is no retry on auth e... |
| REQ-4-13 | README check | Egress IP whitelisting is not available on Workers, so a cPHulk block is cleared by a manual cPanel unblock. |
| REQ-12-3 | automated test | On auth failure: disable the account for the request, tell the caller to check the secret, never retry. |
| REQ-13-7 | README check | A cPHulk block is cleared by hand in cPanel. |
| REQ-14-5 | automated test | Integration tests record the IMAP capabilities of both hosts. |
| REQ-14-6 | automated test | IMAP parser tests run against recorded real responses from the mcptest mailbox, covering response shapes the prototype did not see (large literals, unusual FETCH shapes). |
| REQ-14-7 | automated test | Required protocol tolerance tests: LITERAL+ on, LITERAL+ off, literal mailbox names, auth failure, and silent-server timeout. |
| REQ-14-8 | automated test | The timeout behavior (REQ-4-8, REQ-4-9) is tested with the silent-server fake. |

## Deliverables

- `src/imap/` client: AUTHENTICATE PLAIN with SASL-IR, CAPABILITY, LIST, SELECT, UID SEARCH, UID FETCH (headers, flags, BODYSTRUCTURE, partial BODY.PEEK), APPEND, UID STORE, MOVE, and UID COPY plus STORE `\Deleted` plus UID EXPUNGE when UIDPLUS is present.
- Per-step timeouts exactly as REQ-4-8.
- Auth failure handling per REQ-4-12 and REQ-12-3 (no retry).
- A small Node script (`scripts/record-fixtures.mjs`) Scott runs locally to capture real IMAP responses from both mcptest mailboxes into `test/fixtures/imap/` (passwords read from environment variables, never written). Fixtures must contain no passwords and no live-mailbox data.
- Remove `spike/` once its tests are ported. Delete the spike Worker (`wrangler delete cpanel-mail-mcp-spike`) and note it in the PR.

## Required tests

- Port the spike fake-server tests and extend them: LITERAL+ on and off, literal mailbox names, auth failure, silent-server timeout at each step (REQ-14-7, REQ-14-8).
- Parser tests against the recorded fixtures, including large literals and BODYSTRUCTURE (REQ-14-6).
- Integration (staging): capability capture from both hosts saved into the PR description (REQ-14-5).

## Success criteria (all must hold before the PR is ready)

- All in-scope rows filled and passing.
- Integration job green against both test mailboxes.
- Spike Worker deleted.
- `node scripts/trace.mjs --chunk C1 --strict` passes.
- No new spec questions left unlisted in the PR.
